text:
Type: oval wall mirror with scrolls
Use: reflecting light and decorating a wall, checking an outfit; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: traditional, classic, glam
Materials: mirror glass, thin dark metal frame, wrought scroll ornaments
Colors: dark grey-black metal, silver mirror
Shape: tall narrow oval with a slim metal rim, curled filigree scrolls climbing the upper left and lower right sides, ornate yet airy
Feel: romantic, elegant, whimsical, vintage
Goes with: white or pastel walls, distressed wood, wrought iron, floral textiles; traditional, French country or romantic bedrooms

product.name: EKNE
product.description: Provided with safety film - reduces damage if glass is broken.
